limitations: Credential-free GET-only within a bounded isolated execution namespace.

observations.title: Observed cookie attributes need Secure review
observations.summary: At least one observed Set-Cookie entry lacks Secure in an aggregate; cookie purpose is unknown.
observations.remediation: Classify cookie purpose, and enforce Secure on cookies that must only travel over HTTPS.
observations.limitation: Passive evidence only; exploitability and whole-site coverage unverified.

observations.title: MIME sniffing defense needs review
observations.summary: The observed response did not include an effective X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff value.
observations.remediation: Consider X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff with correct Content-Type.
observations.limitation: Passive evidence only; exploitability and whole-site coverage unverified.

observations.title: HSTS header absent on observed HTTPS response
observations.summary: A complete captured response header set did not include HSTS; this is a hardening signal, not proof of downgrade exploitation.
observations.remediation: Evaluate enabling Strict-Transport-Security with a tested max-age on HTTPS.
observations.limitation: Passive evidence only; exploitability and whole-site coverage unverified.

observations.title: Observed HTML response has no framing policy
observations.summary: Neither X-Frame-Options nor enforced CSP frame-ancestors was captured; this is not clickjacking proof.
observations.remediation: Consider frame-ancestors in enforced CSP or X-Frame-Options according to compatibility.
observations.limitation: Passive evidence only; exploitability and whole-site coverage unverified.

observations.title: No enforced Content Security Policy on observed HTML response
observations.summary: The fully captured response lacks an enforced CSP; this does not prove XSS.
observations.remediation: Introduce and validate a restrictive policy incrementally, using report-only during rollout.
observations.limitation: Passive evidence only; exploitability and whole-site coverage unverified.
